title: DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding: Benchmarking Document Grounding and Hallucinations in Voice Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Voice agents enable low-latency, natural interaction, yet their ability to faithfully ground responses in external documents remains underexplored. We introduce DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding (DSB-DG), a benchmark for evaluating document grounding in voice agents across five professional domains. DSB-DG targets three failure modes: Context Saturation, which measures grounding under increasing document length; Grounding Decay, which measures retention of document facts across multi-turn dialogue; and Proactive Grounding, which evaluates whether context re-injection mitigates conversational drift. The benchmark contains 1,636 adversarially verified QA pairs from 50 documents covering five professional domains, and supports fully automatic evaluation of grounding accuracy, hallucination, and response latency. translated_title: DuplexSpeechBench-文档溯源：语音智能体中文档溯源与幻觉的基准测试
translated_abstract: 语音智能体能够实现低延迟、自然的交互，但其将回复忠实锚定于外部文档的能力仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了DuplexSpeechBench-Document Grounding（DSB-DG），一个用于评估语音智能体在五个专业领域中文档溯源能力的基准。DSB-DG针对三种失效模式：上下文饱和，衡量文档长度增加时的溯源表现；溯源衰减，衡量多轮对话中文档事实的保持能力；主动溯源，评估上下文重新注入能否缓解对话漂移。该基准包含来自50份文档、覆盖五个专业领域的1,636个经对抗验证的问答对，并支持对溯源准确性、幻觉和响应延迟的全自动评估。在对涵盖级联架构、专有全双工与实时架构以及开源权重语音到语音架构的多类系统的测试中，我们发现
tldr: 该论文提出了DSB-DG基准，通过上下文饱和、溯源衰减和主动溯源三种失效模式，首次系统性地评估语音智能体在五个专业领域中的文档溯源能力与幻觉问题，并实现全自动评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DSB-DG, a benchmark that systematically evaluates document grounding and hallucinations in voice agents across five professional domains through three failure modes—context saturation, grounding decay, and proactive grounding—with fully automatic evaluation.
